business_problem: tiket.com needed a more durable and scalable compute and data platform to support millions of daily travel transactions, large traffic spikes, and its push to become a more data-driven and AI-enabled online travel company.
solution_summary: tiket.com consolidated its online travel platform on Google Cloud so booking traffic, analytics, and AI-powered workflows could scale together. Google Kubernetes Engine and Compute Engine provide the resilient compute layer that supports flights, hotels, attractions, and event-ticket bookings, including traffic spikes that exceed one million concurrent users. BigQuery enables near-real-time analysis over the behavior of more than 50 million customers, while Cloud Spanner stores large volumes of operational data used by the company's Data and AI teams for statistical and machine learning models. Gemini models are being integrated into daily workflows and custom agentic chatbots to improve internal productivity and customer-support capabilities. By bringing compute, analytics, and AI together on one platform, tiket.com can keep serving heavy transaction volumes while improving how it responds to market shifts and customer demand.
